name: vlds
description: VLDS — a standalone, runtime epistemic layer: a user-controlled dashboard for a model's own epistemics. Four instruments, each refusing at its own point to treat an inference as fact. The gate routes a load-bearing claim through VERIFIABLE → VERIFIED → CONFIRMED / PENDING / HEDGED, so an action proceeds only on a verified claim and an unverifiable one is stated with its uncertainty attached; it tracks provenance through a neural-net model and classifies each input by storage durability. The guide loop disciplines the need behind the claim — asking when it must, reusing what the user already configured, recording both to an auditable ledger. The inspector re-examines a high-stakes verdict through independent perspectives, blind to the original reasoning and re-grounded in sources, routing it to CORROBORATED / REJECTED / CONTESTED. The gc is a garbage collector for belief state — stored rules, memories, and training-data assumptions marked LIVE / STALE / FREED-RESIDUE / UNOWNED / EXPIRED by tracing provenance to a live root, swept transitively on a retraction, compacted so the lesson survives the directive, and tombstoned against re-learning; it guards three barriers — read (what is recalled), write (what is stored), and dispatch (whether this message was already answered) — and collects the cycle per-item tracing cannot see, previewing rather than sweeping what grew into itself. The instruments are invoked directly; a fifth skill, the looper, surfaces on its own and runs them in order, logging each decision to a shared, user-editable log. A SessionStart override extends the built-in per-project memory system the way a derived class overrides a virtual method, its store — the instrument files plus the gate's storage tiers made literal as partition files — in the working directory's .claude/vlds/ directory. Standalone; no external plugin dependencies.
